string.name: calendar_reason
string.value: Reads (only reads) the events in your phone calendar to show them in Ergo's calendar

string.name: photos_reason
string.value: Only reads when photos in your album were taken (not the photos themselves), summarized by day for Ergo on your own computer

string.name: photo_location_reason
string.value: Reads where photos were taken, to summarize together with the times by day

string.name: location_reason
string.value: Records your location now and then for Ergo on your own computer, summarized as where you went and how long you stayed each day

string.name: microphone_reason
string.value: Records your voice while you hold to talk, and sends it to Ergo
